acceptance_criteria: In-memory GRDB tests: 0/1/2/3 RRs -> correct beat rows and t_end_ms_est; rr_1024 conversion exact; disconnect/reconnect -> paired events; kill-and-resume -> same recording_id, relaunch event, no duplicate start; stop sets ended_at_ms; snapshot opens with plain sqlite3, no sidecars, equal row counts; migration idempotent; n_rr == count(beat). docs/SCHEMA.md matches migration.
notes: DONE. StrapLogCore: WallClock (stdlib owns Clock)/SystemClock/FakeClock; BeatTiming; EventKind; SensorEvent{atMs, Payload: heartRate(bpm,contact?,rr1024)|connected|disconnected|battery|bluetooth}; HeartSource protocol + pump(into:); FakeHeartSource (lazy clock); Schema.v1 (raw SQL, == docs/SCHEMA.md, test-enforced; meta format=straplog, schema_version=1; FKs, indexes); StrapLogDatabase (.live = WAL DatabasePool, .inMemory); records Recording/HeartNotification/Beat/RecordingEvent; RecordingSession actor (start/stop(snapshotInto:)/marker/snapshot(into:)/resumeIfOpen/ingest); Snapshot (VACUUM INTO temp, journal_mode=DELETE, atomic replace; fileName YYMMDD-HHMM-name local); DBInvariants. 35 tests. FOR P3: payload needs rr1024 — use hrValueReceived observer rrs, not rrsMs (docs/SDK-NOTES.md). Session tracks link+battery while idle, so start-while-connected logs connect; connect/disconnect deduped on transitions. start() throws openRecordingExists if an unfinished recording exists -> app must call resumeIfOpen() at launch first. Snapshot holds ALL recordings (filter by recording.id); consider per-recording export later if file size matters. GRDB read/write in async funcs need await.

title: P1 HRVKit pure algorithms
description: RRCleaner (300-2000 ms gate + iterative 5-beat median, 0.25), TimeDomain (RMSSD, LnRMSSD, SDNN, meanHR), DFA alpha1 (scales 4-16), SlidingWindow<T> (120 s / 60 s), ArtifactRate. tools/gen_fixtures.py (uv) from ~/Downloads/hrv260420/DB.sqlite -> Tests/fixtures/<rec>.json with Python reference metrics from analyze_h10.py. See plan: ~/.claude/plans/i-d-like-to-make-velvety-wreath.md (read only this phase's section).
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic tests (constant RR SDNN 0; alternating known RMSSD; white noise a1~0.5; random walk a1~1.5); fixture parity vs Python (RMSSD/SDNN +-0.1 ms, a1 +-0.02, identical artifact counts) on >=3 recordings (resting, strength, overnight); <60 beats -> nil; empty input; NaN handling.
notes: P1 done. HRVKit: HRVDefaults (constants mirrored from analyze_h10), RRCleaner→RRCleaning (removedIndices, kept, artifactRate; non-finite treated as gated), TimeDomain (rmssd, lnRMSSD, sdnn ddof=1, meanHR; nil not NaN), DFA.alpha1, SlidingWindow + TimedSample/WindowSlice (numpy-arange centers, half-open, binary search), WindowFeatures + WindowAnalyzer (= rolling_features). 32 Swift Testing tests green. Parity on 3 fixtures (resting/strength/overnight; 626 windows): identical removed indices + per-window counts, RMSSD/SDNN ±0.1 ms, α1 ±0.02. tools/gen_fixtures.py imports analyze_h10 directly (chart_style stubbed). LEARNED: DFA α1 scales 4-16 reads white noise as ~0.59 not 0.5 (python too: 0.587±0.013) — tests assert estimator value. For P5: WindowAnalyzer.features(of:center:) is the per-window entry LiveMetrics should call; RRCleaner median is O(n·5) per pass, fine for 120 s windows. Fixtures use only ~2-6 artifacts each; synthetic tests cover missed/extra beats.
